jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Open Source Data Platform (ODP)
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking a Principal Engineer with at least 14 years of experience to serve as a technical visionary and thought leader for Acceldata's Open Data Platform (ODP). In this role, you will define the long-term technical strategy, lead the most complex architectural initiatives, and represent Acceldata in the global open-source and distributed systems community. You will work directly with engineering leadership and executives to shape product direction while driving innovation across the organization. WHY JOIN US? As a Principal Engineer at Acceldata, you will be at the forefront of shaping the future of enterprise data platforms, defining the technical vision for systems that power mission-critical workloads across the world's largest organizations. Your decisions will directly influence not only our platform but also the broader data ecosystem through open-source contributions and industry leadership. You'll work alongside Apache members, committers, and industry veterans who are passionate about solving the hardest problems in distributed computing. This is a rare opportunity to combine deep technical impact with strategic influence, building technology that matters while shaping the direction of a growing data observability company.

jobs.description_text: At Acceldata, We are revolutionizing data observability in how enterprises manage and observe data by offering comprehensive solutions tailored to each organization's unique needs. Our platform integrates various technologies, enabling seamless data observability for modern enterprises. This role offers the opportunity to build cutting-edge data solutions, influence the open-source ecosystem, and collaborate with industry experts. Your contributions will have a lasting impact on both the data platform and the broader open-source community.

jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking a Staff Engineer with at least 9 years of experience in distributed systems or data platform development. If you're ready to take ownership of complex technical challenges and drive innovation at scale, Acceldata is where you belong.

jobs.title: Intermediate Software Engineer
jobs.description_text: Engineering @ AltaML - How We Work: We are an AI-first company. Claude Code and AltaML's shared configuration and skills library are the default way engineers design, build, test, and review software, not an optional accelerant a few people use. We expect dramatically higher productivity from working this way. A step change, not a marginal gain. That's the baseline we hire and promote against, not an aspirational ceiling. We believe AI has compressed what used to take weeks into days, and what used to take days into hours. Estimates, sprint commitments, and delivery timelines should reflect that reality, not pre-AI habits. Show us, don't tell us. As part of applying, share an example of your AI-assisted coding: a PR, a repo, a recorded session, or whatever best demonstrates how you actually work with AI day to day. We overpay for the right people. We'd rather pay a premium for an engineer who embodies this and multiplies the team than save money on someone who doesn't. The Intermediate Software Engineer independently owns and delivers well-defined, small-to-medium complexity user stories end to end. You work AI-first by default: using Claude Code and AltaML's shared skills library as your everyday workflow, not a novelty. And, you're building the judgment to take on increasingly novel problems without close supervision.

Position Overview CLO Virtual Fashion에서 3D Design & Implementation Specialist를 채용합니다. CLO의 3D Design & Implementation Specialist는 CLO 소프트웨어 전문가로서 패션/디자인/패턴에 관한 지식을 바탕으로 CLO 유저를 교육하고 서포트하는 역할을 수행합니다. 아울러, 유저의 니즈를 가장 먼저 이해하여 3D 프로세스가 효과적으로 접목될 수 있도록 전문적인 컨설팅을 진행합니다. 이처럼 CLO의 3D Design & Implementation Specialist는 유저가 CLO를 더 효율적이고 가치있게 사용할 수 있도록 컨설팅, 교육, 서포트하는 역할을 수행합니다. jobs.title: 3D Implementation Specialist, CLO
jobs.description_text: CLO虚拟时尚使用先进的3D服装模拟技术，简化了服装设计和生产的全流程。从最初的设计灵感直至最终的成衣试身，我们的服装制作软件能够赋能一件服装诞生的全过程。 公司在2009年创立之初，就致力于打造一个全新的数字时尚生态，同时视环保为己任，坚持贯彻服装制造的可持续性。公司旗下的软件CLO、Marvelous Designer、JINNY，以及数字资产管理平台CLO-SET和CONNECT，共同构建出一套无缝结合数字服装和真实成衣的工作流程。 作为全球领导者，CLO虚拟时尚在全球12个国家共设立了14个独立办公室，服务涵盖北美洲，南美洲，欧洲以及亚洲。在不断增长的全球用户群的推动之下，我们将继续拓展更多不同的市场。 Position Overview 作为技术顾问，帮助服装企业进行数字化工作流程转型。需要了解服装企业的工作流程，了解行业动向和趋势。您是用户与我们的软件开发团队之间的纽带，及时洞察客户需求并和公司其他团队成员合作给出解决方案，使CLO软件的发展与客户需求一致。我们希望您能积极地与全球团队协作沟通， 善于思考，保持好奇心，对时尚和3D充满热情。 我们正处于一个高速发展的阶段，我们希望候选人具备团队协作精神，开放性思维，并能适应多元文化的工作环境。我们是一个全球化，开放，包容，发展迅速的公司，如果你准备好参与到数字赋能时尚的变革中，愿意与公司一起飞速成长，那么我们期待看到你的简历！

jobs.title: Business Development Manager, Marvelous Designer
jobs.description_text: CLO Virtual Fashionは独自のアルゴリズムに基づく3D衣装シミュレーションを強みに、アパレル製品のコンセプト企画からデザイン開発、生産、マーケティング、フィッティング、スタイリングまで、ファッションに関わるあらゆるサービスを提供します。 2009年に設立されたCLO Virtual Fashionは3D衣装シミュレーションに関する独自の技術をもとに、デジタルファッションのエコシステムを構築しています。 3DファッションデザインソフトウェアのCLO、Marvelous Designer、Jinnyや、デジタルファッションに特化したプラットフォームであるCLO-SET、CONNECTを提供し、衣装に関するすべての領域で効率的で持続可能なワークフローを実現します。さらに、これらのソリューションは、CLOのシステムとして、現物とデジタル衣装の相互作用を可能にします。 デジタルファッション市場をグローバルにリードするCLO Virtual Fashionは、現在アジア、北米、欧州、南米などの11カ国に計13箇所のオフィスを展開しており、世界中の多数の顧客企業と共にさらなる事業拡大を進めています。 Position Overview Business Development Managerとして、日本でMarvelous Designerブランドの成長を促進する方を採用しています。Business Development Managerは、過去のユースケース戦略を基にターゲット業界を開拓し、クライアントや自社のデザインチームと協力しながら市場のトレンドや、Marvelous Designerがユーザーに提供できるより良い価値を見出します。 これには、マーケティングからの反応に対したフォローアップ、新しいアウトバウンドへの浸透、パートナー関係の活用、ウェビナーやイベントのフォローアップなどが含まれます。

jobs.title: CX Operations Manager, Marvelous Designer
jobs.description_text: 클로버추얼패션(CLO Virtual Fashion)은 3D 의상 시뮬레이션 알고리즘을 기반으로, 컨셉부터 디자인, 제조, 마케팅, 피팅, 스타일링까지 의상과 관련된 모든 서비스를 제공합니다. 2009년 설립된 클로버추얼패션은 디지털 패션의 새로운 생태계를 만들어 가고 있습니다. 의상 디자인 소프트웨어 CLO, Marvelous Designer, Jinny와 함께, CLO-SET, CONNECT와 같은 의상 콘텐츠에 특화된 플랫폼으로 의상의 모든 여정에 관여함으로써, 효율적이고 지속 가능한 워크플로우를 구축하고 있습니다. 뿐만 아니라, 당사 솔루션을 통해 실제 의상과 디지털 의상이 서로 태그되어 CLO 시스템 내에서 기능할 수 있게 합니다. 글로벌 디지털 패션 시장을 주도하고 있는 클로버추얼패션은 현재 아시아, 북미, 유럽, 남미 등 전 세계 13개국에 총 16개의 오피스를 두고 있으며, 세계 각국의 수많은 고객사를 바탕으로 점점 확장해나가고 있습니다. [Position Overview] 글로벌 Marvelous Designer 유저들이 제품의 핵심 가치를 빠르게 경험하고, 지속적으로 서비스를 이용할 수 있도록 전체 여정을 설계하는 Operations Manager를 찾습니다. User Movement Initiative의 멤버로서 웹사이트 첫 방문부터 온보딩, 그리고 장기 구독에 이르는 유저의 전체 라이프사이클을 데이터 기반으로 분석하고 개선하는 중추적인 역할을 수행합니다. 신규 유저의 전환율(Conversion) 극대화는 물론, 기존 구독자를 위한 차별화된 베네핏 및 리텐션 전략을 주도적으로 기획하게 됩니다. 글로벌 시장, 특히 3D 산업군에서 유저 중심의 문제 해결 역량을 발휘하며, 서비스의 양적·질적 성장을 함께 만들어갈 열정적인 분들의 많은 지원을 바랍니다. [To Apply] ▶︎ 국/영문 이력서(경력기술서) 각 1부 및 자기소개서 * 자기소개서 제출 시 업무와 관련된 경험 혹은 프로젝트 가운데 본인의 기여도가 높은 사례를 서술해 주시면 좋습니다. [Hiring Process] [서류 검토] → [1차 인터뷰] → [2차 인터뷰 (+Reference Check)] → [처우 협의] → [최종 합격] * 1차 인터뷰는 역삼에 위치한 서울오피스에서 오프라인으로, 2차 인터뷰는 온라인으로 진행합니다. * 1차 인터뷰는 한국 및 해외 동료분들과 진행되며, 인터뷰 중 일부는 영어로 진행됩니다. * 2차 인터뷰는 해외 동료분들과 진행되며, 인터뷰는 전면 영어로 진행됩니다. * 2차 인터뷰 조율 과정에서 레퍼런스 체크 요청을 드리고 있습니다.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description_text: 클로버추얼패션 (CLO Virtual Fashion)은 3D 의상 시뮬레이션 알고리즘을 기반으로, 컨셉부터 디자인, 제조, 마케팅, 피팅, 스타일링까지 의상과 관련된 모든 서비스를 제공합니다. 2009년 설립된 클로버추얼패션은 디지털 패션의 새로운 생태계를 만들어 가고 있습니다. 의상 디자인 소프트웨어 CLO, Marvelous Designer, Jinny 와 함께, CLO-SET, CONNECT와 같은 의상 콘텐츠에 특화된 플랫폼으로 의상의 모든 여정에 관여함으로써, 효율적이고 지속 가능한 워크플로우를 구축하고 있습니다. 뿐만 아니라, 당사 솔루션을 통해 실제 의상과 디지털 의상이 서로 태그되어 CLO 시스템 내에서 기능할 수 있게 합니다. 글로벌 디지털 패션 시장을 주도하고 있는 클로버추얼패션은 현재 아시아, 북미, 유럽, 남미 등 전 세계 13개국에 총 16개의 오피스를 두고 있으며, 세계 각국의 수많은 고객사를 바탕으로 점점 확장해나가고 있습니다. Position Overview 이 포지션은 단순히 지표를 분석하는 역할이 아닙니다. Product와 Business의 핵심 문제를 정의하고, 실험을 통해 성장의 방향을 설정하는 역할입니다. 대시보드를 만드는 데서 그치지 않고, 지표가 의사결정과 실제 액션으로 이어질 수 있도록 주도적으로 만들어가는 분을 찾고 있습니다. Data Analyst는 데이터 가공과 분석을 통해 유저가 우리의 제품을 효과적으로 활용할 수 있도록 리드하며, 궁극적으로는 유저의 전체 라이프사이클이 CLO와 함께하도록 기여하는 역할을 수행합니다. CLO Virtual Fashion의 주요 프로덕트(CLO, Marvelous Designer, CLO-SET, CONNECT)에서 생성되는 다양한 데이터를 다루며, 각 팀이 해당 데이터를 의사결정에 효과적으로 활용할 수 있도록 가공·정리하여 조직 내 커뮤니케이션이 원활히 이루어지도록 지원합니다. 또한 직접 가설을 수립하고,가설 검증을 위한 데이터 추출 및 분석 논리 구조를 설계하여 Implication과 Insight를 도출하는 전 과정을 A부터 Z까지 경험하실 수 있습니다. Hiring Process [서류 검토] → [과제 전형] → [1차 인터뷰] → [2차 인터뷰(+Reference Check)] → [처우 협의] → [최종 합격] *1차 인터뷰에서는 영어 인터뷰 및 SQL Live test가 진행됩니다. *2차 인터뷰 조율 과정에서 레퍼런스 체크 요청을 드리고 있습니다.

Position Overview CLO Virtual Fashion의 프로덕트(CLO, Marvelous Designer, CLO-SET, CLO-SET CONNECT) 개발, 운영에 필요한 분석용 데이터를 수집, 정제하여 글로벌 오피스의 직원들에게 제공하는 역할을 맡게 됩니다. Data Engineer로서 데이터를 단순히 이동시키는 것이 아니라, 신뢰할 수 있는 데이터 플랫폼을 설계하고 운영하는 엔지니어를 찾고 있습니다. 배치 처리부터 실시간 스트리밍까지, Modern Data Stack 전반에 걸쳐 데이터 파이프라인의 품질과 확장성을 책임질 분을 기다립니다. Hiring Process [서류 검토] → [1차 인터뷰] → [2차 인터뷰(+Reference Check)] → [처우 협의] → [최종 합격] *서류 제출 시 이력서 및 포트폴리오 제출이 필수이며, 제출하신 자료만으로 판단이 어려운 경우 추가 자료를 요청드릴 수 있습니다.

[Position Overview] 서비스 성장에 따라 인프라 복잡도가 증가하면서, 안정적인 운영과, 반복 작업 자동화, 체계적인 인프라 관리가 핵심 과제가 되었습니다. 우리는 스스로 문제를 발견하고 해결 방안을 제시하며, 이를 끝까지 책임지고 실행할 수 있는 DevOps 엔지니어를 찾습니다. 또한 지식과 경험을 적극적으로 공유하며, 함께 더 나은 개발 환경을 만들어 갈 분을 기대합니다. jobs.title: IT Operations Engineer

jobs.title: 产品设计师 Product Designer (UI/UX)
jobs.description_text: 你的职位概览 在CLO,好的设计不只是好看,更能触动人心。作为产品设计师(UI/UX),你将主导AI Studio及我们不断拓展的Web端产品矩阵背后的界面设计,把复杂的工作流转化为直观、令人愉悦的体验,服务于时尚、影视和游戏开发领域的创作者们。 这个角色属于把设计系统当作一门“活的手艺”而非一份清单的人——属于对AI如何让设计与开发变得更快、更智能、更有温度充满好奇心的人。你将加入上海团队，与产品经理、开发人员和业务团队紧密协作,把想法变为现实,并可以自由尝试Claude、Cursor等工具。 加入我们,一起打造定义未来世界如何设计、创造与协作3D内容的工具。 Role Overview At CLO, great design doesn't just look good — it moves people. As a Product Designer (UI/UX), you'll shape the interfaces behind AI Studio and our growing suite of web-based tools, turning complex workflows into intuitive, delightful experiences for creators across fashion, film, and game development. This is a role for someone who treats design systems as a living craft, not a checklist — and who's genuinely curious about how AI can make design and development faster, smarter, and more human. You'll join the Shanghai Office and work closely with PMs, developers, and business teams to bring ideas to life, with the freedom to experiment with tools like Claude and Cursor along the way. Join us in building the tools that will define how the world designs, creates, and collaborates in 3D.

jobs.title: Beta Engineering Summer 2027 Internship
jobs.description_text: We understand that finding the right place to work isn't easy. At Beta Engineering, we believe in cultivating a team that wins together and takes on the most challenging projects in the high-voltage industry. We engineer, procure, and construct (EPC) projects for a variety of customers, including those in the utility, industrial, and renewable energy markets. Our work includes substations, transmission lines and more. We help our customers achieve their goals of creating a stronger power grid by reducing risks and identifying innovative solutions for their project challenges. Our Purpose: We pursue that which challenges us, growing our community to provide critical, creative solutions that achieve extraordinary results. Our Values: We do what we say, we turn challenges into success and we win together. Beta Engineering has openings for internships in Pineville, LA. Accepting applications for Freshman, Sophomore, Junior and Senior levels. Beta Engineering hosts a 10 week long summer internship program where students will work alongside full-time team members learning about the projects we create. Fields Include: - Construction Management WORKING CONDITIONS: • Will work in an office environment with minimal exposure to dust, noise, and other environmental hazards. jobs.title: Design Automation Engineer
jobs.description_text: Come join our team at DIS-TRAN Steel! Our people – not our machinery - are our biggest assets. DIS-TRAN Steel’s leadership team lives by our company values, modeling our culture of respect and integrity each day. We're a team that likes to have fun, but we also know how to get stuff done. DIS-TRAN Steel is seeking an Industrial Operations Specialist to help drive operational excellence across our manufacturing environment. jobs.title: DIS-TRAN Steel Transfer Portal - Pole Plant 2 Production Welder - Night Shift Opportunity
jobs.description_text: Crest Industries believes that when we have the right people in the right seats, we can achieve unlimited success. Our Transfer Portal is designed to empower our team members to learn, grow and build their careers throughout our family of companies. This form is for any employee in the Crest Family of Companies to apply for open positions at DIS-TRAN Steel. DIS-TRAN Steel is looking for an experienced Welder to join the team in Pole - Plant 2 at the Pineville Plant on Night Shift. The Production Welder must be capable of performing all welds needed on our structures and must understand instructions given in regard to the welds. This individual must be able to perform duties with speed and accuracy in order to produce a quality product and keep a steady flow through the facility. This position will frequently use calculating skills, by tape measure or other device. This position will use other moving machinery or equipment, including cranes, in order to manipulate steel structures. If you have interest in this opportunity, please apply and the DIS-TRAN Steel talent team will contact you and help you through the rest of the process. If you have any questions or issues with the portal please contact your Talent Manager: Marianne Dore' (DTS Pineville & Eunice Plants) email to marianne.dore@crestoperations.com or text to 318-467-1774 For other current open opportunities, please see those specific Transfer Portal opportunities and apply at https://jobs.lever.co/crestoperations?depa

jobs.description_text: Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place! The role is explicitly broader than a traditional DevOps engineer and explicitly more hands-on than a pure architect.

With Level AI, you will get to have fun, learn new things, and grow along with us. Ready to redefine possibilities? Join us!

jobs.title: Senior Flight Test Engineer
jobs.description_text: We are seeking a Flight Test Engineer to operate within the Flight Test team. Candidate will work with ground and flight operations, engineering, and other LTA teams, to develop test plans and direct flight test efforts for our revolutionary large rigid airship flying from Moffett Field in Sunnyvale, CA. We’re looking for an engineer to foster safe, effective flight testing. The Flight Test Engineer will develop test plans and test hazard analyses (THA), draft airship limitations, lead ground and flight tests, perform data analysis, write test reports, and document test results. This position will also contribute to the development and review of the Airship Flight Manual (AFM) and other operational documents by collaborating with multiple teams to provide pertinent information.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description_text: This role will design and develop complex mechanical, thermal, and fluid systems for flight and ground equipment, working across cross-functional engineering teams to validate system integrations and support manufacturability from design through qualification testing.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (CA)
jobs.description_text: LTA Research and Exploration, an aerospace start-up, is seeking a motivated Senior Software Engineer to help build a revolutionary ‘lighter than air’ flight vehicle. You will work within a dynamic engineering and design team to plan, conceptualize, rapidly prototype, test and implement innovative solutions for the design, fabrication, and assembly of large experimental flight vehicles. We believe in fast-cycle development and approach to flight systems development with the motto "build a little, test a little, learn a lot". This unique position allows for hands-on leadership through all phases of development, from concept to flight of an experimental aerospace vehicle. We are seeking a high energy, passionate Senior Software Engineer to help further the development of software for safety critical systems as well as actively test and validate rapidly developed software on the Airship.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Safety Engineer (CA)
jobs.description_text: LTA is seeking a Systems Safety Engineer to serve as a senior individual contributor and technical authority within the Systems Engineering function. Operating at the principal level, this engineer applies broad mastery across subsystems and disciplines beyond their core area to architect and validate new, complex system-of-systems and integration approaches where no legacy solution exists. The Principal Systems Engineer sets the overarching technical direction for a systems discipline, owns the system-level safety, verification, and certification strategy for a vehicle program or major system, and acts as a subject-matter expert during internal audits and regulatory interactions. This is a role for a proven technical leader who provides leadership and direction to multidisciplinary, integrated product teams, mentors and develops senior engineering staff, shapes program-defining architectures and drives the integration and certification of lighter-than-air flight vehicles.

jobs.title: Test Engineer
jobs.description_text: The Baby Airship team is seeking a dedicated test engineer to contribute to our flight test operations of our sub-scale model. We are looking for a versatile engineer with experience in three critical domains—Mechanical, Software, or GNC—to integrate directly with our hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing and flight prototyping workflows. The test engineer will work with flight test plans, execute flight test preparations, and work with the rest of the team to analyze flight test data. The test engineer will also work on assisting the team to improve the fidelity of the Baby Airship as a sub-scale model of Pathfinder 1.

Kitware's Open Source Software Technology Program (OSTP) is a full-time position for talented and curious new Computer Science and Computer Engineering graduates, offering an opportunity to launch their careers while earning a master's degree in Computer Science. You'll work on real-world open source software projects, develop your technical and leadership skills, and complete your graduate education - all while earning a competitive salary. You'll gain experience developing innovative software with applications across areas such as computer vision, scientific computing, data and analytics, medical computing, and software solutions. Along the way, you'll learn not only how to build and maintain powerful open source platforms, but also how successful technical projects are led, funded, and sustained. How it Works OSTP Software Developers join Kitware as full-time, permanent employees from day one. The program is designed to combine professional software development experience with graduate study, with the master's degree typically completed over a three-year period. Throughout that time, you'll work on-site at Kitware's Clifton Park, NY headquarters while completing your master's coursework. Your work schedule is designed with the demands of graduate study in mind, with flexibility during the academic year to balance your Kitware responsibilities and coursework. jobs.title: Senior Software Architect
jobs.description_text: Team Description: Kitware'scomputer vision team is a leader in the creation of cutting-edge algorithms and software for automated image and video analysis. Our solutions embrace deep learning and add measurable value to government agencies, commercial organizations, and academic institutions worldwide. We understand the difficulties in extracting, interpreting, and utilizing information across images, video, metadata, and text, and we recognize the need for robust, affordable solutions. We seek to advance the fields of computer vision and deep learning through research and development and through collaborative projects that build on our open source software platforms, such as VIAMEand Telesculptor. About the Projects: By joining our team, you will be contributing your software development expertise in the areas of computer vision and/or machine learning to develop robust solutions for real-world problems. Our projects focus on areas such as 3D reconstruction, object detection, image manipulation detection, and motion pattern learning and anomaly detection. Kitware’s employees have unique opportunities to interact and collaborate directly with customers, visit interesting customer sites, and participate in live field tests and demonstrations. Research and Development Engineers at Kitware also have the opportunity to publish and maintain open source software packages.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Singapore
jobs.description_text: About the Job As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Field AI, you’ll be at the forefront of bringing our autonomous systems to life in the real world, owning deployment, integration, and ongoing performance in the field. This role is equal parts engineering and problem-solving. You’ll work hands-on with both customers and our internal teams to ensure successful operations, rapidly incorporate field feedback to improve reliability and performance, and drive adoption so our systems become mission-critical from day one. If you thrive in fast-paced, high-impact environments and want to see your work directly enable the future of autonomy, this is the role where you’ll make it happen.

jobs.title: Robotics AI Engineer
jobs.description_text: Robotics AI Engineer Location: Singapore Field AI is transforming how robots interact with the real world. We are building risk-aware, reliable, and field-ready AI systems that address the most complex challenges in robotics, unlocking the full potential of embodied intelligence. We go beyond typical data-driven approaches or pure transformer-based architectures, and are charting a new course, with already-globally-deployed solutions delivering real-world results and rapidly improving models through real-field applications. About Field AI Field AI is at the forefront of robotic embodied AI, transforming industries like construction, security, mining, and manufacturing. Our autonomous robots operate globally, often in harsh environments, delivering critical insights to customers. Whether monitoring construction progress, ensuring safety compliance, or conducting predictive maintenance, Field AI is advancing technology to make a meaningful impact. Learn more at https://fieldai.com. About the Job As a Robotics AI Engineer, you will design and deploy AI algorithms that enable robots to perceive, reason, and act in unstructured environments. jobs.title: Research Engineer
jobs.description_text: Do you believe the path to general-purpose physical AI runs through noisy, real-world factory deployments? Are you excited by the challenge of turning the classical robotic stacks into the foundational training data for physical AI? Do you want to bridge the gap between world-class ML research and industrial-scale robotic execution? If your answers are yes, we should talk. At Nomagic, we are executing a humble pivot for general-purpose physical AI. We believe that physical AI is fundamentally a knowledge transfer problem - we are leveraging the "internet data" of robotics - massive deployment logs from real systems operating in production environments - to bootstrap our efforts. We are looking for Research Engineers who will help us to build, train, and deploy foundational models that bring our fleet from a classical control stack to generalized AI mastery.
